title: Sum of N Numbers
author: Raj
statement:
You are given an integer **N** followed by **N** integers. Print the sum of the N integers.

**Note:** The sum may exceed the range of a 32-bit integer, so use a 64-bit integer type (e.g., `long long` in C++ or standard integers in Python).
inputFormat:
The first line contains a single integer **N** (1 ≤ N ≤ 10⁵).

The second line contains **N** space-separated integers **a₁, a₂, …, aₙ** (−10⁹ ≤ aᵢ ≤ 10⁹).
outputFormat: Print a single integer — the sum of the N integers.
editorial: Read N, then read N integers and accumulate their sum in a 64-bit integer (`long long` in C++, standard unbounded integer in Python). Print the final accumulated result. Time complexity: O(N) to iterate through all inputs. Space complexity: O(1) if read iteratively or O(N) if stored in an array. Common pitfall: 32-bit integer overflow when summing 10⁵ numbers of magnitude 10⁹.

samples.explanation: Only one number, so the sum is 42 itself.
